ambiguity_notes: Tie-break rule within rajayoga rule 2; blemish assessment is a lordship computation outside the DSL.

ambiguity_notes: Ordinal weighting of functional benefic lordships; informational ranking, no chart condition.

consequent.text: Gradation among benefic lords: 9th > 5th; 10th > 7th > 4th (least).

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

consequent.text: Adjust judgment for the native's age, position, status and sex.

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

consequent.text: Weigh exaltation and debilitation of the house lords.

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

consequent.text: Weigh the house lord's strength, aspects, conjunctions and location.

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

quote: 3. The natural qualities of the house, of its lord and the planets in it or having aspects.

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

consequent.text: Weigh the Navamsa situation of the house lord and of its dispositor.

quote: 6. The situation—favourable or adverse—of the house-lord or the lord in whose house the particular house-lord is situated, in the Navamsa.

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

quote: 4. Whether the influence has been altered by any yogas occurring in any particular house or houses.

ambiguity_notes: Procedural directive; which 'other appropriate diagrams' apply per house is left to the astrologer.

consequent.text: Judge a house from the Rasi, the Navamsa and other appropriate divisional charts, not the Rasi alone.

quote: In examining a house due importance should be given not only to the Rasi but also to the Navamsa and other appropriate diagrams.

consequent.text: Benefic lords: lagna lord (unless the Moon), trikona lords (5, 9), and kendra lords (4, 7, 10) when they are not natural benefics.

quote: In any horoscope the benefics or benefic lords are :— (1) First house lord, other than the Moon; (2) the 5th and 9th lords (Thrikonadhipathis); (3) and (4) lords of the 4th, 7th and 10th when they do not happen to be natural benefics.

ambiguity_notes: Lordship-classification rule; see functional_benefic_lords_general for the proposed impl.

consequent.text: Malefic lords: lords of 3, 6, 11; and kendra lords (4, 7, 10) when they are natural benefics (Kendradhipatya dosha).

quote: The malefics or malefic lords in a horoscope are :— (1) Lords of the 3rd, 6th and 11th houses; (2) lords of the 4th, 7th and 10th houses (Kendradhipathis) if they happen to be natural benefics.

ambiguity_notes: Lordship-classification rule; luminaries exempted from 2nd/8th/12th lordship blemish.

quote: The neutrals in a horoscope are:—(1) The Moon—when he is lord of Lagna, (2) the Sun or the Moon as the 8th lord, (3) the Sun or the Moon as the lords of the 2nd and 12th.

consequent.text: Primary marakas: (i) lords of the 2nd or 7th, (ii) malefic occupants of the 2nd or 7th, (iii) malefic planets associated with those lords.

quote: (i) Lord of the 2nd or 7th is a determinant of death; (ii) the (malefic) occupants of these two houses, and (iii) the (malefic) planets in association with the above lords are also determinants of death.

consequent.text: Secondary marakas: benefics associated with the 2nd/7th lords; lords of the 3rd and 8th; and the 3rd/8th lord associated with a 2nd/7th lord.

quote: The following may also become Marakas or death-inflicting planets :— (1) Benefic planets in association with lords of 2nd and 7th, (ii) lordsof 3rd and 8th and (iii) lord of 3rd or 8th associated with 2nd or 7th lord.

ambiguity_notes: Doctrinal override of an exemption stated in 'certain works'; cf. LAGNA_MARAKA_OVERRIDES ('spares'/'kills') in app/medini/ml/raman_saab/raman_method_v2.py, which carries per-lagna exemptions from HPA — this HTJAH passage warns against applying blanket exemptions.

consequent.text: Raman rejects the classical exemption: the Sun, the Moon and the 9th lord CAN act as marakas in practice.

quote: It is suggested in certain works that the following planets will not cause death, (i) The Sun and the Moon and (ii) the 9th lord. In actual practice, however, this is not found to be true.

consequent.text: Tertiary marakas: Saturn in conjunction/association/aspect with marakas; the lord of the 6th or 8th; and the least powerful planet in the horoscope.

quote: (c) Tertiary Determinants of Death—(Q) Saturn in conjunction, association or aspect with the Marakas (determinants of death) mentioned above, (ii) lord of the 6th or 8th whether or not he is associated with a Maraka planet, and (iii) the least powerful planet in the horoscope.

ambiguity_notes: General transit principle; the Saturn-over-2nd-from-Moon observation is chart-specific commentary, kept only as timing detail.

consequent.text: Transit influences weigh heavily in timing death.

timing.detail: e.g. Saturn transiting the 2nd from the radical Moon at death (Chart No. 5 commentary)

quote: Of course in the determination of death, the transiting influences have a great bearing.

ambiguity_notes: Stated within the Chart No. 5 discussion but asserted as the doctrinal mechanism for Purnayu. The lord's exaltation is not parametrizable (dignity_is takes a concrete planet); affliction is approximated as malefic occupation/aspect of the lord's house (the 5th here).

consequent.text: An exalted, unafflicted Lagna lord confers Purnayu (full term of life).

quote: The lord of Lagna is exalted in the 5th without any unfavourable aspects, conjunctions or associations. This has conferred Purnayu or full term of life.

ambiguity_notes: Encoded as every planet aspecting the 1st; 'all planets' is read as the seven grahas.

consequent.text: All planets aspecting the ascendant: strong, wealthy, long-lived.

quote: If all the planets aspect the ascendant he will be strong, wealthy and long-lived.

consequent.text: The four elements of house judgment: the house, its lord, its occupants and its karaka.

quote:
Several elements are required for judging a 
horoscope, viz., (a) the house, (b) its lord, (c) its occupants, and (d) its Karaka or indicator.

consequent.text: Jupiter or Venus in a kendra or trikona from Lagna: favourable results.

quote: If Jupiter or Venus remains in quadrants or trines from Lagna, favourable results are produced.

consequent.text: Complexion, appearance, character, fame and success are read from the strength of the Lagna and its karaka (Satyacharya).

quote: one's complexion, caste, physical appearance, mental characteristics, nature of birth, fame and defame, success, etc., should all be based on the strength or otherwise of the Lagna and the Karaka.

ambiguity_notes: Raman gives a stronger 'well disposed / fortified' variant of this placement; the lord-strength qualifier has no DSL leaf (proposed impl: lord_strong), so only the base placement is encoded here.

consequent.text: Rahu in Lagna with the Lagna lord conjunct a malefic: fear of deception.

quote: If the lord of birth is in conjunction with an evil planet and Rahu occupies Lagna, the person has fears from deception.

consequent.text: Rahu, Mars and Saturn together in the ascendant: trouble in the sexual organs.

consequent.text: Saturn in the ascendant: theft or being cheated.

consequent.text: A dry (Sushka) planet — Sun, Mars or Saturn — in the Lagna: a lean body.

ambiguity_notes: Encoded for Cancer; the rule covers Cancer/Scorpio/Pisces — separate _r records or an any-of-sign form would cover all three. 'Good planets' read as the natural benefics.

quote: He will be corpulent if ascendant be Cancer, Scorpio, or Pisces with good planets.
